# Ogun State towns (10 Oct 2026)

**What it is:** three small towns reached by road: **Shagamu** (junction town, first stop out of Lagos), **Abeokuta** and **Ijebu Ode**. Generated by `tools/gen-ogun.mjs` into `server/config/cities/ogun-*.json`, registered in `index.json`. Each is a full city for the multi-city rules (own presence, chat, ads, shops, jobs, homes, venues, spawns). No airport: Ogun is road travel only (plan 17, section 4).

**Everything is a FICTIONAL layout with real town names and two real landmark ideas (Olumo Rock, adire cloth). Streets, sizes, prices and offers are NOT verified; someone from Ogun State must review it.**

## The road network (fares ESTIMATE, through the ledger)
| From | To | Fare |
|---|---|---|
| Lagos mainland (Okada Road north gate, "Lagos-Ibadan Expressway") | Shagamu | 800 |
| Shagamu | Abeokuta | 400 |
| Shagamu | Ijebu Ode | 400 |
Each link has its way back. Abeokuta and Ijebu Ode connect through Shagamu (two hops from Lagos), which is why Shagamu is the "transport hub". You stand at the gate, press the chip, pay, and the page reloads in the other town (same system as the Lagos district links).

## The towns
- **Shagamu** (440 x 320 m): Lagos Road and Benin Road east-west, Market Road and Ibadan Road north-south, a curved Station Crescent, a **roundabout interchange**, **Shagamu Motor Park** (a public car park with a fee, rows of yellow minibuses and an open shed), a motor park dispatch job (`job_rider`), junction market, Junction Square.
- **Abeokuta** (400 x 290 m): a solid **rock outcrop** (stacked rounded tiers and boulders, generic, "Olumo-style", collides like a building), an **adire dye yard** (the same dye-pit yard as Kano, with its own name) and an **Adire cloth market** venue (poster, word board, rules), market, Rock Road curve.
- **Ijebu Ode** (400 x 290 m): the **cheap first move out of Lagos**: homes cost about 60 to 65 percent of the Lagos mainland price (a test checks rents are below Lagos and the other towns); Palace Square is a generic square (the palace is not depicted); old-town streets and a market.
- Every town has a Mart, market stall, clinic, POS kiosk, canteen with Whot and Ayo, 10 to 15 homes, 3 or more jobs, 5 to 6 billboards for the ad portal.

## NOT done / NOT verified
- Real layouts, street names, fares and house prices; whether "Olumo-style Rock" should be named at all (its real site has shrines, and the game version is only a generic rock, not a copy).
- No buses or bus stops, no ride-hailing across towns, no train. Each town's NPC traffic is the shared Lagos mix (danfo, keke, okada), which may not match.
- Ijebu Ode's "slower pace" is only the cheaper homes and fewer buildings; there is no separate NPC density setting yet.
- No Yoruba text. No mosque or church buildings yet (the Lagos ones were approved by name; these were not).
- On-phone speed of these towns was measured only in software rendering (see smoke).

## Tests
`tests/ogun.test.js` (registry and validity, reachability and link symmetry, driving Lagos > Shagamu > Abeokuta > Shagamu > Ijebu Ode > Shagamu > Lagos with each fare through the ledger, Ijebu Ode rents, what makes each town different, motor park geometry) and `scripts/ogun-smoke.mjs` (screenshots, a road link in the browser, a canteen).
